subject.title: fix(commands): re-check owner for cross-channel /allowlist writes

question: Should cross-channel `/allowlist` mutations be authorized only by explicit origin `commands.ownerAllowFrom` authority or gateway `operator.admin`, rather than by target-channel identifier matching?
rationale: The current model has no cross-transport principal-mapping contract, so target-channel string matching can both reject documented explicit owners and conflate unrelated identities.

options.title: Require transport-independent authority
options.body: Expose explicit owner-match provenance and allow cross-channel writes only for that authority or gateway-admin scope.

options.title: Define cross-channel principal mapping
options.body: Pause this fix until OpenClaw has an explicit contract for proving that identities on different transports represent the same operator.

recommendation.title: Require transport-independent authority
recommendation.body: Expose explicit owner-match provenance and allow cross-channel writes only for that authority or gateway-admin scope.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the closest merged security hardening on the same `/allowlist` origin-and-target authorization path.
